rules.from: Han Jaemok is of the 2126 generation. He grew up beside the depot workshop at Yangpyeong 2-dong and learned early to count bolts and bearings. His grandfather left behind a workshop key and a stock sheet instead of a company name. With that key Han Jaemok developed the habit of handing out no part until the ledger matched, and even now he does not open the workshop until the stock sheet is fully reconciled. When the Free City's repair crews looked for someone to entrust with parts allocation, Han Jaemok gathered the support of the workshop people and took the director's seat. In winter he writes fuel and food counts beside the parts ledger and has welding fires lit only after the shutters are closed.
